corinthians2.8.p1.b1.text: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.

corinthians2.8.p1.b2.text: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.

corinthians2.8.p1.b3.text: …Of their own accord, they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.

corinthians2.8.p2.b1.text: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.

corinthians2.8.p2.b2.text: But just as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you —see that you also excel in this grace of giving.

corinthians2.8.p2.b3.text: I am not making a demand, but I am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.

corinthians2.8.p3.b1.text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ…

corinthians2.8.p3.b2.text: …though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.

corinthians2.8.p3.b3.text: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.

corinthians2.8.p4.b1.text: It is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.

corinthians2.8.p4.b2.text: As it is written: “He who gathered much had no excess…”

corinthians2.8.p4.b3.text: “…and he who gathered little had no shortfall.”

corinthians2.8.p5.b1.text: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you.

corinthians2.8.p5.b2.text: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.

corinthians2.8.p5.b3.text: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.

corinthians2.8.p6.b1.text: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.

corinthians2.8.p6.b2.text: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you.

corinthians2.8.p6.b3.text: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
